errors.text: The proposed free-surface nucleation mechanism is incompatible with the target bulk model's periodic boundary conditions; the target identifies vacancy clusters or locally disordered atoms as nucleation sites.
Chemical short-range order is assigned a central mechanistic role without evidence that SRO was initialized, quantified, or observed in the target FeNiCrMn simulation.

The cited free-surface evidence concerns nanowires, and the cited SRO-dislocation evidence concerns a BCC MoNbTaW refractory HEA, so neither directly validates the claimed mechanism in periodic FCC FeNiCrMn.
